function.description: Get a wallet's open Jupiter Lend EARN positions — supplied assets/balances (raw atomic units) plus accrued earnings, per position. Covers Earn (simple lending) only — for collateralized Borrow positions (collateral/debt) use solana.lend.borrowPositions instead.
function.name: solana__lend__positions

walletAddress.description: The wallet ACCOUNT to read, as a Solana address (not a token mint or a position key). Defaults to the session's selected Solana wallet — omit it to read your own. Under session scope a DIFFERENT address is rejected.
